graph.title: Batmobile
notes: The manual pages are low-resolution pictures with no readable text, so many exact stud positions and some piece placements are best guesses. The part inventory is exact: 45 pieces, matching the parts list. Connections are the least certain part.

Build order used: 1 plate 4x4; 2 two grate slopes; 3 yellow 2x6; 4 two wheel holders; 5 first corner plate; 6 grey 2x6 on top; step 7 sub-assembly of 1x4 plate, two trans-yellow tiles and the curved brick, fitted to the front; 8 red round plates plus the second corner plate; 9 front arches; 10 flames and a 1x2 plate; 11 mudguard; 12 grate slopes and 2x2 grey plate; 13 canopy and rear wings; 14 wheels and tyres.
The second 2420 corner plate (b45) is not clearly visible in the manual; I assumed it mirrors b7 on the other rear slope.

Where the model is flipped (step 8 onward), anti-stud and stud ports were assigned plausibly, not read exactly. The 4287b inverted slopes (b18, b19), the 3023 wing plates (b33, b34), the clip tiles (b35, b36) and the 1x6 tiles (b31, b32) have uncertain attachment points.
Wheel holders have no axle port in the catalogue, so wheels join the holder with a null holder port, as a revolute push-on. Tyres are joined rigidly to wheels with no ports.
